metadata.question: Did Punjab and Haryana have less than 20,000 fires detections in November, 2024, as observed with the VIIRS sensor?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use VIIRS active fire daily 1 km image collection NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14A1. Filter by date 2024-11-01 to 2024-12-01 and region = Punjab + Haryana (GAUL Level1 for India).
2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking (active fire product already encodes detections). Derive a binary detection: MaxFRP > 0 if available; otherwise FireMask >= 7.
3. Logic: Check collection size (C1). Ensure valid pixels exist in region (C2). Compute detection sum and verify non-null/non-NaN (C3). Compare total detections against 20000 to output A/B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const start = '2024-11-01';
    const end = '2024-12-01';
    const admin1 = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level1');
    const india = admin1.filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'India'));
    const punjabGeom = india.filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM1_NAME', 'Punjab')).geometry();
    const haryanaGeom = india.filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM1_NAME', 'Haryana')).geometry();
    const comboGeom = punjabGeom.union(haryanaGeom, 1);

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    let col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14A1').filterDate(start, end);
    const size = await col.size().getInfo();
    console.log(`Dataset: NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14A1`);
    console.log(`Nov 2024 images: ${size}`);
    if (!size || size === 0) {
      console.log('No images in date range.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // Determine usable band
    const first = ee.Image(col.first());
    const bandNames = await first.bandNames().getInfo();
    let fireBand = null;
    if (bandNames && bandNames.indexOf('MaxFRP') !== -1) {
      fireBand = 'MaxFRP';
    } else if (bandNames && bandNames.indexOf('FireMask') !== -1) {
      fireBand = 'FireMask';
    }
    console.log(`Bands: ${bandNames}`);
    console.log(`Band used: ${fireBand}`);
    if (!fireBand) {
      console.log('No suitable fire band found.');
      console.log('D');
      return;
    }

    // Valid pixel count check (C2)
    const validCount = await first.select([fireBand]).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: comboGeom,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e10
    }).get(fireBand).getInfo();
    console.log(`Valid pixels (first img @1km): ${validCount}`);
    if (!validCount || validCount === 0) {
      console.log('No valid pixels in region after processing.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing: build binary detection per image
    const detCol = col.map(function(img) {
      img = ee.Image(img);
      const det = ee.Algorithms.If(
        fireBand === 'MaxFRP',
        img.select('MaxFRP').gt(0),
        img.select('FireMask').gt(6) // FireMask: 7,8,9 = low/nom/high confidence fire
      );
      return ee.Image(det).rename('det').toFloat();
    });
    const monthlySum = ee.ImageCollection(detCol).sum().rename('det');

    // 4. Calculation: counts per state and combined
    const punjabSum = await monthlySum.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: punjabGeom,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e11
    }).get('det').getInfo();
    const haryanaSum = await monthlySum.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: haryanaGeom,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e11
    }).get('det').getInfo();
    const comboSum = await monthlySum.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: comboGeom,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e11
    }).get('det').getInfo();

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    if (punjabSum === null || haryanaSum === null || comboSum === null ||
        !isFinite(punjabSum) || !isFinite(haryanaSum) || !isFinite(comboSum)) {
      console.log('Computation returned null/NaN.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const p = Math.round(punjabSum);
    const h = Math.round(haryanaSum);
    const t = Math.round(comboSum);
    console.log(`Punjab detections: ${p}`);
    console.log(`Haryana detections: ${h}`);
    console.log(`Combined detections: ${t}`);
    console.log(`Threshold (<20000): ${t < 20000}`);

    // Final tag
    if (t < 20000) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error:', err);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
